_allowed_comment: is_allowed is the event's own IsAllowed gate, lifted from the decompile as one boolean expression over base-game member names (identifiers only). CurrentActIndex is ZERO-BASED: act 1 is 0. TotalFloor counts every floor of the run, not the act's. A clause reading Players.All(...) is asked of every player in a co-op run.
